_doc: Fase de combustible de cada investigación y, para CADA tabla de PSI, la columna de O2, la de presión (con su unidad) y qué filas son pruebas. Lo usa scripts/auditar.py para recalcular coverage_by_environment recorriendo todas las tablas, no solo las citadas, para que los ceros también se comprueben. Vale solo cuando 'approved_by' tiene el nombre de quien lo revisó contra los CSV. Si aparece un CSV nuevo en stages/01_ingesta/output/psi/ que no esté aquí, el auditor falla.

PSI-142.source: docs/datos-psi-inventario.md (column 'Combustible'); ground study (inventory has no fuel phase); left out of every phase

PSI-10_Experimental table_Flame Design_I.note: inverse flame: XO2 is the burner stream, as in CFI-G Inverse. 11 cells are text ('RAMP', 'LOW O2')

PSI-10_Experimental table_Flame Design_N.note: initial O2 and initial pressure, like 'before test' in CFI-G

PSI-142_Experimental table_Data Summary.note: ground study without a fuel phase; not counted

PSI-159_Experimental table_CFI-G_Inverse.note: XO2 is the burner stream, not the chamber

PSI-159_Experimental table_CFI-G_Normal.note: same columns the Calculator cites in F-002

PSI-20_Experimental table_ACME BRE.csv.note: rows are test days; O2 is a list per day; no pressure column ('chamber pressures were also varied but are not identified')

PSI-21_Experimental table_CLD Flame.csv.note: no O2 column; rows are test days

PSI-22_Experimental table_ACME E-FIELD F.note: no O2 column; rows are test days

PSI-23_Experimental table_ACME s-Flame.c.note: O2 only as text in 'Atmosphere*' (e.g. '~30% and ~21% O2 with He'); not readable as numbers, so these days count as O2 unknown

PSI-26_Experimental table_BASS.csv.note: no O2 column: its 122 tests count as O2 unknown

PSI-39_Experimental table_CFI.csv.note: 'Oxygen' has no unit in the header (values 0.17-0.21: fraction, see unidades-columnas.json); pressure cells read like '1 atm'

PSI-68_Experimental table_Flex2.csv.note: rows are a matrix of conditions

o2: O initial ambient composition; mole fraction
PSI-69_Experimental table_FLEX.csv.note: same columns the Calculator cites in F-002

PSI-98_Experimental table_SAFFIRE-1.csv.note: rows 3-4 are flow-visualization data, not tests

PSI-99_Experimental table_SAFFIRE-2.csv.note: rows 10-15 are flow-visualization data and footnotes, not tests
